_comment: Functions deliberately removed from the source, which are still present in
the currently deployed Worker because it predates the removal.
check-drift.mjs fails when the deployed script contains a function this repo
does not, because that is what an out-of-band deploy looks like. A commit
that legitimately deletes or renames a function looks identical, and without
this file it would block every deploy from then on — which in practice means
somebody disables the check, and the guardrail is worth more than that.
An entry here is a claim, made in a reviewable diff, that a name's
disappearance was intended. Entries become unnecessary the moment the deploy
lands; the check says which ones can go.

removed.name: ruleWhitelistForRole
removed.why: Superseded by the station-aware audience: allowedRuleIdsForRole (SQL pre-filter) + alertVisibleTo (per-row station/target refinement) now gate every alert surface. The old rule_id-only shim had no remaining callers, so esbuild tree-shook it out of the bundle.
